title: SharkNinja discontinues certain messaging following Dyson NAD challenges
summary: Claims around SharkNinja’s SilkiPro Straight Hair Straightener and Dryer were challenged by rival Dyson with the National Advertising Division (NAD) regulatory body in the US

products.name: SilkiPro Straight Hair Straightener and Dryer

extraction.key_fact: Dyson의 이의 제기로 SharkNinja가 헤어 기기 광고 문구 일부를 중단했다.
